text_block_list.text:
One day, after training, with the Oka Sho 
right around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally right before our eyes, 
huh.
choice_data_list:
The race is right around the corner, so 
let's get some good rest.

The race is right around the corner, so 
let's make sure to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mm. We cannot afford to catch a cold and 
run a fever. You get some proper rest as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? Is that――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--!

In the direction of Air Groove's gaze, an 
Umamusume was running with a fiercely 
determined, almost demonic expression.

"If I recall, she's Mejiro Dober. The girl 
who came out to cheer during Air Groove's 
debut race."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Please head back ahead of me.

"...Even though I was told to head back 
first, I can't help but worry about the 
two of them."
I decided to quietly observe from afar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You're overworking yourself, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I never intended to teach you such 
self-destructive training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What happened?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I feel so pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Unable to do anything, I—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen... Ryan, too... They're both way 
ahead of me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Those two don't let the pressure of being 
Mejiro family Umamusume get to them... and 
they deliver results...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I'm still... crushed by nerves, 
and I can't even run properly...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one left behind... It's so 
frustrating, I hate it so much, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Unable to do anything... I hate myself... 
so much for being so pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Dober. Do you possess... an 'ideal'?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When I lost my way and came to a halt, 
where was I aiming to go? What did I want 
to become? How was I supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What reminds you of that and guides your 
way... is the 'ideal' within yourself."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To me, my "ideal" is— my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle against a wonderful 
rival, my mother conquered the Oaks and 
became a queenâthat figure of hers...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seizing glory at the end of relentless 
daily discipline, I felt a powerful 
yearning for that proud, noble presence.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to become like my mother, so I 
came to this academy... and took on the 
challenge of the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Midway along the path, when I was about to 
lose myself, and even when hardships 
brought me to my knees—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That 'ideal' guides me forward. 'Come 
this far,' it calls, fiercely, again and 
again."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I will surely win the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks), and catch up to Mother—to that 
'ideal'. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One day, I will surpass Mother and reign 
over uncharted domain. Leading all 
Umamusume—as the "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That is what I am working hard for 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of that radiant 
"ideal"— that I can keep running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Let me ask you once more, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Tell me... do you have an 'ideal'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My... "ideal"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Until now, all I cared about was... not 
bringing shame to the Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I respect McQueen and the others... but 
more than that... I just don't want to 
lose...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I just can't... figure out 
what this 'ideal' is supposed to be..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Try and catch me, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Your senpai?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What I strive to be is a presence that 
guides all Umamusume. In other words, the 
'ideal' for every Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you say you don't yet have an "ideal" 
within you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall become your "ideal."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As proof of that... please watch my 
challenge for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I swear I will show you a figure worthy of 
your "ideal."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Don't catch a chill. Catching a cold 
this time of year is unexpectedly 
troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Didn't I tell you to head back first?
choice_data_list: I just couldn't leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. You always were that kind of 
person.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

I must support Air Groove so she can 
become the "ideal" for many Umamusume— 
Under the setting sun, I renewed my firm 
vow.
